name: SkyPilot Catalog AWS GPU instances extract - Key instance types with per-hour rates
notes: Fetched 2026-10-04. Extracted GPU instance rows from the SkyPilot AWS v8 catalog (5.3MB CSV). The catalog includes ALL EC2 instances with GPU accelerators across all AWS regions. Instance types include: p5.48xlarge (8x H100, $55.04/hr on-demand us-east-1), p5.4xlarge (1x H100, $6.88/hr), p5en.48xlarge (8x H200), p4d.24xlarge (8x A100, $32.77/hr), p4de.24xlarge (8x A100 80GB), g5.12xlarge (4x A10G, $6.55/hr), g5.48xlarge (8x A10G), g6.12xlarge (4x L4, $2.48/hr), g6.48xlarge (8x L4), trn1.32xlarge (8x Trainium), trn2.48xlarge (8x Trainium2). Spot prices are typically 40-70% below on-demand. The catalog also includes newer instance types like p6 (B200) where available. This is the raw data behind the GPU Compass portal. All prices are per-instance-hour, NOT per-GPU-hour - must divide by AcceleratorCount to get per-GPU rates.
